precommitted_interpretation_checks: Gross segment revenues Q3 minus Q2: Exchanges -273, fixed-income/data +21, mortgage -3 USD million; together -255, exactly the gross total-revenue change. This is a gross segment accounting bridge, not a business-causal attribution.
Gross revenue falls -255 while transaction-based expenses implied by gross less net fall -123, so net revenue after those expenses falls -132. Do not conflate gross and net revenue.

Operating expenses fall -9, so operating income changes -123: net revenue -132 minus expense change -9. Net income attributable to ICE falls only -35 and is not fully explained by the selected operating lines.
The statement first lists nine-month/six-month year-to-date columns. Select the third numeric column for the current standalone Q3 or Q2 quarter; the first numeric column is not a quarterly fact.
Adjacent-quarter selected facts do not prove a durable franchise trend, causal driver, valuation, or trade.
